title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Given an unsorted array of integers `nums`, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence in O(n) time.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
hints: Insert all elements into a hash set for O(1) membership check.
Only start counting sequence length if `num - 1` is NOT in the set.
This ensures each number is part of at most one forward sequence check, ensuring O(n) total.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = set([int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]])
    best = 0
    for x in nums:
        if x - 1 not in nums:
            y = x + 1
            while y in nums: y += 1
            best = max(best, y - x)
    print(best)
else:
    print(0)
